title: fix(hono)!: createHonoApp reads a dispatched body by plugin-hono-server's rule, so a text/plain or undeclared body is refused when a domain reads it
body:
Fixes #24042

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

## What

`createHonoApp` (`@objectstack/hono`) now reads a dispatched body by the rule `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` applies (`readRequestBody`, `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/request-body.ts`), media type by media type. Every refusal still rides the refuse-on-read value PR #24005 introduced for #23914, so a refusal is answered only when a dispatched domain reads the body, after the dispatcher's gates. One file changes in `src`: `readDispatchBody`, its docblock, and module-private copies of the twin's messages and of `declaresBody` beside `RequestBodyRefusal`. Nothing new is exported.

| body (`POST` / `PUT` / `PATCH` on the catch-all; every method but `GET` / `HEAD` on the `/auth/*` fallback) | base | head |
|---|---|---|
| declares `application/json` (case-insensitive `includes`) | parsed; blank is `{}`; unparseable is refused on read | unchanged |
| `multipart/form-data` or `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` | `{}` | parsed from a CLONE by Hono's `parseBody` (the function `c.req.parseBody()` runs on the twin); a form that does not parse is refused on read, with the twin's form message |
| any other media type, or none, when the request declares a body (RFC 9112 section 6.3: `Content-Length` other than `0`, or `Transfer-Encoding`) | parsed as JSON when it parsed (step 4 honoured), `{}` otherwise | refused on read, with the twin's message ("The request body was sent as text/plain, which this server does not read into a request body. ..."), naming the media type only when it is a plain token pair |
| no body declared | `{}` (or parsed) | `{}` |

The JSON-sent-as-`text/plain` case (#23914's step 4) is the "other media type" row: refused, not parsed. `content/docs/api/wire-format.mdx` already names `Content-Type: application/json` as required (`:11`, `:594`); no sentence there becomes false, so it is untouched.

## Measured at the door: the real dispatcher and data domain through `createHonoApp`

A temporary file in `packages/qa/http-conformance` (the `hono-body-refusal.conformance.test.ts` boot: a real `LiteKernel`, ObjectQL, sqlite-wasm, the real `HttpDispatcher` and `/data` domain), each body sent with `Content-Length` as a client sends it. The base column is the same file with the base reader put back through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (blob `a4b335ae969d` to `d060fe2070b0`, restored, `git diff HEAD` empty). The file was deleted after both runs and is not in the diff.

| request | base reader | head |
|---|---|---|
| step 4: `POST /data/task/query` `{"where": {"status": "churned"}}` as `text/plain` | 200, records (parsed and honoured) | 400 `INVALID_REQUEST`, "sent as text/plain" |
| `POST /data/task/query` `hello` as `text/plain` | 200, records (`{}`, the empty query) | 400 `INVALID_REQUEST` |
| `PATCH /data/task/ID` `{"name":"HACKED2"}` as `text/plain` | 200, the name changed | 400 `INVALID_REQUEST`, the row unchanged |
| `POST /data/task/query` urlencoded `where=...` | 200, records (`{}`, the empty query) | 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` (`query.where` is a string) |
| `POST /data/task` urlencoded `name=from_form&status=active` | 201, a row with no name | 201, a row named `from_form` |
| `PATCH /data/task/ID` urlencoded `name=HACKED` | 200, no field changed | 200, the name changed |

The three form rows are the parsed fields reaching the domain, which is what the self-hosted door already hands it (see Acceptance notes).

## PM mechanism assumptions, measured at base `b1d5569d9`

1. **No first-party caller sends a JSON body without `application/json`, or a body with no `Content-Type`, to the hosted door.** Holds.
   - This repo has no production `createHonoApp` host: every importer is a test (`packages/adapters/hono`, `packages/qa/http-conformance`), docs or a comment. `packages/cli` mounts none.
   - `packages/client`: `this.fetch` defaults `Content-Type: application/json` (`index.ts:7450`); the one direct `fetchImpl` with a body is the presigned upload, which goes to the storage surface, not through `dispatch()` (the dispatcher has no `/storage` domain).
   - A windowed scan of 307 request-body sites in 1309 files of `examples/`, `packages/qa/dogfood`, `scripts/`, `packages/cli/src` and `packages/client/src`: every platform poster declares JSON; the rest are GitHub API calls, flow-node configs or response shapes.
   - The console at the pin `f8267df93aba` (`.objectui-sha`): `approvalsApi.call`, `CloudConnectionPanel.getJson`, `FormPage`'s `apiFetch`, `useRecordApprovals`'s `fetchJson`, `DatasourceResourcePage`'s `api`, plugin-chatbot's `call` and `serverActionHandler` all set `application/json`, and none of their body-carrying calls passes headers that would replace it. `ApiDataSource` sends `text/plain` only for a string body, and its three console instances are `GET` doors. No `sendBeacon`. `UploadProvider`'s XHR PUTs to the presigned raw door. `data-objectstack`'s `uploadFile` / `uploadFiles` post multipart to `/api/data/OBJECT/upload`, but nothing calls them at the pin and no server route serves that path.
   - NOT MEASURED: the cloud repository, the main `createHonoApp` host, is not in this container.
2. **Parsing a form from a clone leaves the forwarded request unread.** Holds: the raw-request form row asserts `bodyUsed === false` at dispatch and the exact bytes on the request; a new row pins the cache path (an upstream `c.req.parseBody()`, then the catch-all hands the parsed form from Hono's cache).
3. **What domains do with a form body now.** Measured on the data domain (table above). Every domain that reads `body` (data, meta, packages, actions, analytics, automation, keys, ai, notifications, security, share-links, permission-set-clone, catalog-activation, mcp) now receives a form's fields where it received `{}`, as it does on `plugin-hono-server`. The forwarders (`/approvals/act`, `/webhooks/redeliver`, the inbound automation hooks) never read `body`, and the legacy auth domain never reads its `_body`. No first-party caller posts a form to a body-reading domain (assumption 1); the one first-party form post, `/approvals/act`, is a forwarder.
4. **`dispatch()` reads no body before its gates.** Holds. `dispatch()` holds `body` in the handler's argument literal only (`http-dispatcher.ts` `:2890`, `:2989`) and its gates take the path and headers. Measured on the real dispatcher and the real plugin-webhooks member, hosted door against the self-hosted mount over a socket, with a temporary copy of `hono-webhooks-redeliver.conformance.test.ts` (deleted after): anonymous `text/plain` garbage, anonymous `application/octet-stream` and anonymous no-`Content-Type` bodies all answer `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` at both doors; signed-in `text/plain` and no-`Content-Type` garbage answer the member's `400 "Request body must be JSON."` at both; a signed-in valid JSON body sent as `text/plain` for an unknown delivery answers `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` at both. Status, headers and body bytes equal on every row.

## Tests

All runs are under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` on head `f0c5d3bdc`, each exit code captured before any pipe.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/hono exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: 9 files, 207 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/hono typecheck`: exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit` and `-p tsconfig.test.json`; both edited test files are in that program by `--listFiles`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-hono-server exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: 30 files, 386 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/http-conformance test`: 14 files, 150 passed. `hono-webhooks-redeliver.conformance.test.ts` (its `not JSON` row included), `hono-approvals-act.conformance.test.ts` (the form `POST` redeeming a live token through `createHonoApp`) and `hono-body-refusal.conformance.test.ts` are unchanged and green: 3 files, 17 passed in a verbose run.
- Closure first: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/hono...' --filter '@objectstack/plugin-hono-server...' --filter '@objectstack/http-conformance...' build`, exit 0.

Pins:

- `hono-body-refusal.test.ts` (43 cases). The parity case drives BOTH doors over one 21-row table and holds status and body equal: for a refusal the same `code` and `message`, for a read body the same value. Rows: valid, truncated, `{ not json`, another case spelling, blank and whitespace-only JSON; a urlencoded form, a malformed urlencoded form (read leniently by Hono's parser on both doors, so both answer 200 with the same fields), a multipart form, and a multipart form that does not parse; step 4 as `text/plain` and as `text/plain;charset=UTF-8`, plain text, a body with no `Content-Type`, `application/octet-stream`, a `+json` suffix type, a media type that is not a token pair, and a body framed by `Transfer-Encoding`; and three no-body rows. New reader rows: step 4, plain text, `octet-stream`, no `Content-Type`, the `/auth/*` fallback and a malformed multipart form, each refused 400 though the domain answered its own 500. A new forwarder row: a `text/plain` garbage body reaches the forwarder, which answers its own refusal with every byte read. The CONTROL form row now expects the parsed fields.
- `hono-catch-all-raw-request.test.ts`: as #24042 mandates, the rows `JSON sent as text/plain` (`:101`), `invalid JSON that does not declare JSON` (`:106`) and `plain text` (`:109`) move to the new answers, and so does `a form body` (`:108`), whose answer the form row of the rule changes. They move out of the table (which compares against the old reader line) into a new describe, each sent with `Content-Length`: the three are handed on as a body whose read throws `status 400` / `INVALID_REQUEST`, a no-`Content-Type` row is added beside them, and the form is handed on parsed (`{ token: 'def', x: '1' }`); every one still asserts `bodyUsed === false` and the exact bytes on the forwarded request. One more row pins the form cache path. Every other row of the file is unchanged and green.

## Red at base, green at head, and one ablation per row group

Each leg through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode (anchor hit once, the write proven on disk by the anchor count and the blob, the restore proven: blob equal to `HEAD`'s `a4b335ae969d`, `git diff HEAD` empty). The suite imports `./index` and resolves `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` to its source (`vitest.config.ts`), so no rebuild sits between a mutation and its run. Run: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/hono exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/hono-body-refusal.test.ts src/hono-catch-all-raw-request.test.ts` (63 cases).

| leg | mutation | blob | result |
|---|---|---|---|
| base | `readDispatchBody` replaced by the base body | `a4b335ae969d` to `d060fe2070b0` | 25 failed (every new row), 38 passed |
| ablation A | the "other media type" branch puts back the content-type-blind parse | `a4b335ae969d` to `9858d8bde495` | 17 failed: exactly the undeclared-body rows of both files; every form row green |
| ablation B | the form branch hands `{}` again | `a4b335ae969d` to `ae5e64d9423c` | 8 failed: exactly the form rows (parity urlencoded, malformed urlencoded, multipart, malformed multipart; the CONTROL form row; the reader's malformed-form row; the raw-request form row and its cache row) |
| head | none | `a4b335ae969d` | 63 passed |

17 plus 8 is the 25 that are red at base.

## Gates

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `f0c5d3bdc` (no paths, merge base `b1d5569d9`): 64 commands. In the first sweep, over the closure build, 63 exited 0 and `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it reads every package's `dist/`). After `pnpm turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs' --concurrency=2` (exit 0, 75 tasks) it exited 0: "110 published require entry point(s) across 68 package(s) load". Reconciliation with that reading: "64 derived, 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the three changed `.ts` files: exit 0, no findings. The repo-wide run is CI's `Lint & Repo Gates`.
- Control-byte scan over the four changed files: no hits.
- `@objectstack/hono`'s built `dist/index.js` (CJS, `require("hono/utils/body")`) and `dist/index.mjs` both load and export `createHonoApp`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Form bodies now reach the domains on this door.** A form posted to a domain that reads `body` was `{}` here and is its parsed fields now, as on `plugin-hono-server`: on the data domain a form query is `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` where it read every row, a form create writes the form's fields where it wrote an empty row, and a form `PATCH` applies where it changed nothing (table above). The rule is the seat's; no first-party caller posts such a form. `text/plain`, like the two form types, is a media type a browser sends cross-origin without a preflight, and a JSON body sent that way is no longer honoured here.
- **Seat ruling B (`6226688716`, supersedes `6226633450`).** The pending `.changeset/23914-hono-body-refusal.md` bullet "A body that does not declare JSON is read as before: parsed when it is JSON, `{}` when it is not." is superseded by this PR's changeset. It is left in place because the #17712 guard gates any edit of another PR's pending changeset on a person's confirmation. `carrier:` the release owner, at `changeset version` time: drop that bullet from the compiled `@objectstack/hono` entry.
- **Presence by framing headers.** As on the twin, a body is present only when the request declares `Content-Length` other than `0` or `Transfer-Encoding`. An in-process `Request` built without either reads as no body on both doors, and so would a runtime that delivered a body with neither header. Carrier: none.
- **Message copies.** The twin's `NOT_EMPTY`, `namedMediaType`, `malformedFormMessage`, `unreadMediaTypeMessage` and `declaresBody` are mirrored module-private, beside the two messages PR #24005 mirrored; the parity table holds the two doors' answers equal for every row.
- **The `/auth/*` arm.** The only in-repo reader on that arm, the legacy auth domain, never reads its `_body`, so no answer changes there today.
- **Not merged with `origin/main`.** `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` `b6805ac0f` is clean; of the five incoming commits, one touches `packages/runtime/src/domains` (the read-only refusal on `POST /packages`) and none touches this reader or its tests.
- **Not run locally:** `test:repo` (CI's `Test Core`).

## Contract review

`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`: the seat serves the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review before the queue. One changeset, `.changeset/24042-hono-undeclared-body-refusal.md`, `minor` for `@objectstack/hono` under the launch-window convention for breaking changes, with the `Clause-②` line, the adr-0087 HTML-comment marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` with the other categories closed on facts (as #23914's carry), FROM / TO per row, and the integrator's fix: send `Content-Type: application/json`.
